name: forge-dctap
description: DCTAP forge bundle for edf-forge: parses the Dublin Core Tabular Application Profile JSON-LD meta-vocabulary (dctap-elements.jsonld) into the universal forge property contract (DmeStandardRoot + roles, native-URI stableIds, canonical ownership edges HAS_CLASS/HAS_PROPERTY/HAS_OPTION_SET/HAS_VALUE, SUBCLASS_OF, searchText, embeddings). JSON-LD family (follows the CTDL trailblazer). STANDARD-PURE meta-vocabulary — no cross-standard edges. Harvested-and-adapted from the old forge-dctap parser. JSON source — no js-yaml needed.
author: tqii
